answer: Each epoch a public randomness beacon is the anchor for one draw: every identity gets a sealed review task it cannot choose, and files its judgment before other reviews appear. Auditors compare it with independent reviewers of the same item and pay only judgments that predict those peers above chance; copied text is rejected. Each extra identity must do its own real review, so the small nectar of reward never covers a clone's labor. Limitation: a clique (say, team onyx) can pre-agree scores, so recurring identical clusters are slashed.
